name: SAM machine: 36-word speech synthesizer (Braids Renaissance SAM)
description: One extra machine after Chord: SAM, the Software Automated Mouth of Braids Renaissance. SHAPE picks one of 36 words, COLOR is the speaking rate (centre 100%, independent of the note), SWEEP is the scrub / start frame, CONTOUR is the throat/mouth character macro (centre = exact SAM 128/128), DECAY the release, PUNCH loops the word and GATE holds it.
source: tools/machines/sam, package port of the standalone SAM machine

uses.why: COLOR shows the speaking rate, SHAPE the word, SWEEP the scrub and CONTOUR the character macro instead of numbers

emulation.tool: none yet; the standalone SAM was measured in its source tree

unchanged: every track that does not use SAM

emulation.tool: tools/emu/test_sam.py in the real OS voice loop (Unicorn), on the composed alone build
